proof_body:
by
  intro V _ _ a b c hli x y z
  have ha : a ∈ affineSpan ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set V) := subset_affineSpan ℝ _ (by simp)
  have key : ∀ P : V, P ∈ affineSpan ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set V) ↔ ∃ s t : ℝ, P - a = s • (b - a) + t • (c - a) := by
    intro P
    rw [← AffineSubspace.vsub_right_mem_direction_iff_mem ha P, direction_affineSpan, vectorSpan_eq_span_vsub_set_right ℝ (show a ∈ ({a, b, c} : Set V) by simp)]
    simp only [Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton, vsub_eq_sub, sub_self, Submodule.span_insert_zero, Submodule.mem_span_pair]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨s, t, h⟩; exact ⟨s, t, h.symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨s, t, h⟩; exact ⟨s, t, h.symm⟩
  rw [key]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, t, h⟩
    have h0 : ∀ g : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ i, g i • (![a, b, c] i) = 0 → ∀ i, g i = 0 := Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp hli
    have h1 := h0 ![x + s + t - 1, y - s, z - t] (by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val]
      linear_combination (norm := module) h)
    have e0 := h1 0
    have e1 := h1 1
    have e2 := h1 2
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val] at e0 e1 e2
    linarith
  · intro h
    refine ⟨y, z, ?_⟩
    have hx : x = 1 - y - z := by linarith
    rw [hx]; module
target_source: ∀ (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] (a b c : V), LinearIndependent ℝ ![a, b, c] → ∀ x y z : ℝ, (x • a + y • b + z • c ∈ affineSpan ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set V) ↔ x + y + z = 1)
